OPERATIONAL_NARRATIVE: Stone has completed drilling and initial completion operations of the EW 306, OCS-G 07917, Well A03ST3.  The well was spud on June 30, 2008, kicked off at 12248' MD and drilled to a TD of 16478' MD / 11151' TVD, w/a MW of 12.3 ppg on July 05, 2008. Operations to set a 5" prod. liner resulted in the liner being stuck off bottom at 15145' MD / 9900' TVD. Subsequently, the wellbore was cleaned out to allow for the setting of a 3 1/2" prod. liner for completion operations.  However, during the operations to clean out the wellbore, the well was inadvertently deepened to 16560' MD / 11227' TVD with the new TD of the well being July 12, 2008. The well was then completed for production in the "LH" Sd. with completion operations completed on 07-27-08.
